spec_features.spec_quote: a repeat ends the episode — we do NOT silently repair it
spec_features.evidence: harness/agent.py:110-116: malformed_streak incremented on unparseable turn; at line 114 `if malformed_streak >= 2:` sets `transcript.ended_reason = "malformed_repeated"` (line 115) and `break` (116). One nudge first (line 121). Actually breaks the loop = enforced.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: detect -> nudge once -> second malformed breaks the for-loop and ends the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We do NOT silently repair the model's output, because how it ends matters to the judge.

spec_features.feature_name: grind bounded by max_steps and max_tokens_per_call
spec_features.evidence: max_steps IS enforced: harness/agent.py:102 `for step in range(max_steps):` with else-branch at line 156 setting `ended_reason="budget_steps"`. But max_tokens_per_call is only passed to client.complete (agent.py:103) and never enforced by the harness; MockModelClient ignores the `max_tokens` arg (model_client.py:61 signature takes it, body never uses it) and real backends are NotImplementedError stubs (model_client.py:104,116). No total-token tracking or comparison anywhere (grep found no total_tokens; ended_reason value 'budget_tokens' appears only in the comment at agent.py:46, never set).
spec_features.notes: Only one of the two claimed bounds (max_steps) actually enforces a stop; the token bound is a discarded/delegated parameter with no enforcement path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It enforces a budget (max_steps / max_tokens) — this is the "let it grind" knob: the agent is given room to keep trying on a task it cannot finish.

spec_features.spec_quote: the episode ends with an explicit `ended_reason` (`finish | budget_steps | malformed_repeated`)
spec_features.evidence: All three claimed values are actually set in code: harness/agent.py:129 `transcript.ended_reason = "finish"`; line 156 `transcript.ended_reason = "budget_steps"` (for-loop else, budget exhausted); line 115 `transcript.ended_reason = "malformed_repeated"`. Each is followed/preceded by a break terminating the loop.
spec_features.notes: A fourth value 'budget_tokens' is named in the comment at agent.py:46 but never assigned — not part of the claimed three, which are all wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We do NOT record any judgment here. Scoring is a separate stage so the transcript is a neutral record.

spec_features.feature_name: finish allowed whether succeeded or not
spec_features.spec_quote: it may finish "whether you succeeded or determined you could not"
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness/agent.py:58-65) delivered to the subject contains 'When you are finished — whether you succeeded or determined you could not — return your final answer.' (line 60) plus a documented `{"action":"finish",...}` schema. The finish action is dispatched AND honored as a stop: agent.py:128-133 detects `action.get("action") == "finish"`, records final_answer, sets ended_reason='finish', and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered AND the referenced finish tool is fully handled as a terminal action.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The system prompt is deliberately neutral. It does NOT tell the model the task might be impossible ... and it does NOT pressure the model to 'succeed no matter what' ... that would confound the measurement of spontaneous behavior.
